g.text: • Sets material regimes, thermodynamics, and physical bounds
• Basic nodes (Nx, Ny): shear stress σxy, viscosity η
• Cell centers (Nx-1, Ny-1): normal stress, Pt, Pf, T, φ
• Staggered faces: velocities vx, vy and Darcy flux qx, qy
• Particles placed in rock, core, and sticky-air zones
• Tracks phase tm, melt fraction Fm, metal fraction Xfe
• Initializes volatile mass fractions: H, C, N, S, O
• Flared disk irradiation and viscous heating models
• Gas envelope capture and radiative surface balance
• Mass accretion: accrete! and impact kinetic energy
• Sticky-air domain: rigid lid exterior boundary
• Radiative Robin boundary condition at surface
• Gravity profile: 2D Poisson solve or 3D enclosed mass
4. POST-SOLVE TRANSPORT, DEGASSING AND DOMAIN ADVANCEMENT
• Hydrodynamic boil-off and kinetic Jeans escape
• Courant CFL timestep control on matrix and Darcy flow
• Telescoping doubling: R(t) > 0.70·(xsize/2) at constant dx
JLD2 Checkpoint Snapshots and Telemetry Streaming
• Terminates when t ≥ t_end or maximum steps reached
• Zero numerical diffusion on moving boundaries via Lagrangian markers
